query:
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS (
    TOPN (
        12,
        FILTER (
            'Sales Data',
            'Sales Data'[Customer Rating] <= 2
                && YEAR ( 'Sales Data'[Sales Date] ) = 2020
        ),
        'Sales Data'[Final Sales Price], DESC
    ),
    "SalesId", 'Sales Data'[Sales Id],
    "SalesDate", 'Sales Data'[Sales Date],
    "Country", 'Sales Data'[Country],
    "Product", 'Sales Data'[Product Name],
    "Rating", 'Sales Data'[Customer Rating],
    "Reason", 'Sales Data'[Complaints Reason],
    "Amount", 'Sales Data'[Final Sales Price]
)
ORDER BY [Amount] DESC
